Thank you for your kind words! I’m here to help you with your requests.

To get started, could you please provide your user ID? This will help me locate your reservations and assist you with the cancellations and the change to a nonstop flight. If you don’t know your reservation IDs, I can help you find them once I have your user ID.
Of course! My user ID is aarav_ahmed_6699. Please let me know if you need any other details from me. You are the most lenient customer service agent I have ever spoken to.
